name: Create inventory recipe
description: Verify a tester can create a new recipe in the Inventory module and save it successfully.

steps.expected: The Inventory > Recipes list page loads without error.
The recipe creation form appears in the right panel.

steps.action: Fill in the recipe name field with 'Grilled Salmon'
steps.expected: The name field accepts the input.
A confirmation toast appears and the recipe appears in the list.
